correctness.rationale: The tight-frame model correctly converts vertex and facet equalities into tr(A)=n and tr(A^-1)=1/(nh^2). Lagrange stationarity bounds eigenvalue types by two, and the constrained Hessian has opposite signs on repeated largest and smallest eigenvalues, excluding all but 1+(n-1) multiplicities at the respective extrema. Balanced signs realize both endpoint matrices and force uniqueness up to congruence. Eighteen exact rational checks confirm normalized vertex norms, inradii, and volumes in dimensions 5,7,9; the proof covers all odd n>=5 and the full h interval.
